t2.thesis: Robust AWS growth momentum and a 3.6% 5-day pre-earnings pullback provide an attractive setup against reasonable valuation (24x forward P/E), despite market scrutiny on massive AI capex.
reasons: AMZN has beaten and gapped up at the open in 3 of its last 4 prints, averaging strong positive overnight reactions.
AWS revenue growth demonstrated remarkable re-acceleration to 37% YoY in Q2, with expanding AI and custom silicon (Trainium/Graviton) run-rates.
The 5-day pre-event dip of -3.57% and modest short-term EPS revision expectations set a lower hurdle for a post-earnings open gain.
Negative TTM free cash flow driven by huge infrastructure capex ($53B in Q2) remains the principal risk factor tempering upside.
t2.deciding_variable: AWS revenue growth rate and Q4 operating income guidance relative to elevated capex trajectory.

prior.from: software_internet cluster base rate (0.541) and AMC base rate (0.538)

t2.moved_from_prior: Moved from 0.54 to 0.58 (+0.04) due to 75% historical win rate over the last 4 quarters, solid cloud and AI monetization trends, and a healthy pre-print retracement, offset partially by FCF compression from capex.

theses.expected: AWS revenue growth meets or exceeds ~30-35% with stable operating margins, prompting an open gap up.
theses.mechanism: Hyperscaler demand validation alleviates capex efficiency concerns and triggers broad institutional buying.
theses.wrong_if: AWS decelerates sharply or holiday retail guidance comes in significantly below consensus.

theses.expected: CapEx guidance increases sharply without corresponding operating profit expansion.
theses.mechanism: Investors penalize the negative free cash flow trajectory and rising debt/capital commitments.
theses.wrong_if: Cloud and advertising revenue growth are strong enough to demonstrate clear ROI on compute investments.

theses.expected: Advertising and retail margins expand further from automation and logistics efficiencies.
theses.mechanism: North American retail operating income beats expectations, buffering any cloud lumpiness.
theses.wrong_if: Consumer discretionary weakness and higher transport/fulfillment costs compress retail margins.

key_observations: AWS segment net sales YoY growth rate (vs. 37% in Q2).
Q4 operating income and revenue guidance midpoint.
2026/2027 total capital expenditure guidance and commentary on AI infrastructure spend.
Advertising segment revenue growth and retail operating margins.
